integrity: The polynomial formula and the asymptotic laws have self-contained proofs in RESULT.md. Independent finite arithmetic checks reside in artifacts/check.py. No claims of independent validation or formal certification.
limitations: Only standard centered unit-weight graphical zonotopes of K_{2,n}, integer n>=2, under uniform sampling of distinct vertices; no claims about arbitrary weights, volume sampling, other bicliques or normal-cone sampling. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Two-scale Euclidean chord spectra of two-hub graphical zonotopes
